stories.title: User Dashboard
stories.description: As an authenticated user, I want to view a dashboard containing workspace statistics and recent workspaces so that I can quickly understand my activity and access my projects.
acceptance_criteria: Display the authenticated user's dashboard after successful login.
Display a sidebar containing Dashboard, Workspaces, Stories, Analytics, and Settings navigation options.
Display a welcome message containing the user's first name.
Display summary cards showing total workspaces, total stories, and completed stories.
Display the workspace name and number of stories for each recent workspace.
Allow users to open a workspace by selecting it from the recent workspace list.
Redirect users to the workspace creation page when the 'New Workspace' button is clicked.
Display a notification icon in the dashboard header.
Display the authenticated user's profile information in the header.
Only authenticated users should be able to access the dashboard.
business_rules: Only authenticated and active users are allowed to access the dashboard.
Users must only see workspaces they own or have permission to access.
Dashboard statistics must be calculated using data accessible to the authenticated user.
Recent workspaces must be ordered by the most recently accessed or updated workspace.
Unauthorized users attempting to access the dashboard must be redirected to the login page.
api_requirements: GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary - Retrieve dashboard statistics including total workspaces, total stories, and completed stories.
GET /api/v1/workspaces/recent - Retrieve recently accessed workspaces for the authenticated user.
GET /api/v1/users/me - Retrieve authenticated user profile information.
database_tables: users: id (UUID, primary key), first_name (VARCHAR), last_name (VARCHAR), email (VARCHAR, unique), password_hash (VARCHAR), is_active (BOOLEAN), created_at (TIMESTAMP), updated_at (TIMESTAMP)
workspaces: id (UUID, primary key), name (VARCHAR), description (TEXT), owner_id (UUID, foreign key), created_at (TIMESTAMP), updated_at (TIMESTAMP)
user_stories: id (UUID, primary key), workspace_id (UUID, foreign key), story_id (VARCHAR), title (VARCHAR), description (TEXT), status (VARCHAR), created_at (TIMESTAMP), updated_at (TIMESTAMP)
workspace_members: id (UUID, primary key), workspace_id (UUID, foreign key), user_id (UUID, foreign key), role (VARCHAR), created_at (TIMESTAMP)
validation_rules: The dashboard must only load when a valid JWT access token is available.
Dashboard statistics must contain non-negative numeric values.
Only workspaces accessible to the authenticated user may be displayed.
Workspace names must not be empty.
The 'New Workspace' button must only be available to users with workspace creation permission.
ui_requirements: Display a persistent sidebar navigation on desktop screens.
Display the company logo at the top of the sidebar.
Highlight the currently selected navigation item.
Display the heading 'Dashboard' at the top of the main content area.
Display a personalized welcome message below the dashboard heading.
Display dashboard statistics using separate summary cards.
Display total workspaces, total stories, and completed stories as summary metrics.
Display the 'Recent Workspaces' section below the summary cards.
Provide a primary blue 'New Workspace' button.
Display workspace entries using cards or list rows with rounded corners.
Display a notification icon and user profile section in the header.
Collapse the sidebar into a mobile navigation menu on smaller screens.
The dashboard must be fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
